trunk.extremeprogression.ranged.10.desc: A 10%% chance to recover your arrows from a slain mob.
trunk.extremeprogression.ranged.20.desc: Arrows fly 5%% faster, so they drop less.
trunk.extremeprogression.defense.5.desc: Your shield is ready 1 tick sooner.
trunk.extremeprogression.defense.15.desc: Natural regeneration starts 2 seconds sooner after a fight.
trunk.extremeprogression.mining.5.desc: +3%% breaking speed with pickaxe and shovel.
trunk.extremeprogression.mining.10.desc: A 5%% chance that a block costs no durability.
trunk.extremeprogression.mining.15.desc: 10%% less damage from dripstone, magma blocks and falling gravel or sand.
trunk.extremeprogression.mining.20.desc: A 5%% chance of a double ore drop (not Ancient Debris).
trunk.extremeprogression.foraging.10.des: 10%% more saplings, apples and sticks from leaves.
trunk.extremeprogression.foraging.15.des: Berry bushes no longer prick you.
trunk.extremeprogression.foraging.20.des: A 5%% chance of a double log.
trunk.extremeprogression.farming.10.desc: A 5%% chance of an extra crop.
trunk.extremeprogression.farming.15.desc: Babies you bred grow up 10%% faster.
trunk.extremeprogression.farming.20.desc: Food made from crops fills +1 hunger.
trunk.extremeprogression.fishing.10.desc: A 10%% chance that a catch costs the rod no durability.
trunk.extremeprogression.exploration.5.d: 5%% less fall damage. Not in heavy armor.
Sprinting costs 5%% less hunger. Not in heavy armor.
+5%% swimming speed. Not in heavy armor.
A 10%% chance that a fall deals only half damage (20%% when you land sneaking). Not in heavy armor.
trunk.extremeprogression.smithing.20.des: A 10%% chance that fuel is not consumed.
trunk.extremeprogression.arcana.5.desc: Brewing stands you fill brew 5%% faster.
trunk.extremeprogression.arcana.10.desc: A 10%% chance that enchanting costs 1 lapis less.
trunk.extremeprogression.arcana.20.desc: A 10%% chance that enchanting costs 1 level less.
spec.extremeprogression.blade.ability.de: For 3 seconds the next hit that lands on you is fully parried, and you strike back with a guaranteed crit plus bleeding. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.blade.tradeoff: −15%% damage against targets in heavy armor.
spec.extremeprogression.crusher.style: Heavy blows, breaking armor and staggering.
Your next full hit within 5 seconds releases a shockwave: every enemy within 3 blocks is knocked back, and their armor is 0 for 8 seconds. Cooldown 5 min.
For 6 seconds you ignore the attack bar, and every hit builds your combo. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.brawler.tradeoff: Works only with an empty hand and without a chestplate of iron or heavier.
spec.extremeprogression.sniper.ability.d: Zoom in like a spyglass. Your next full shot within 8 seconds is a guaranteed crit and pierces 1 target; a headshot deals +100%%. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.sniper.tradeoff: −20%% damage on targets closer than 8 blocks.
spec.extremeprogression.skirmisher.style: Moving while shooting, and fast reloads.
spec.extremeprogression.skirmisher.abili: For 5 seconds every shot fires 3 arrows in a fan, for the price of 1 arrow. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.harpooner.style: Throwing, pulling in, water and rain.
spec.extremeprogression.harpooner.abilit: Your next thrown trident pulls the target to you. Cooldown 4 min.
For 6 seconds your shield blocks from all directions, and allies up to 3 blocks behind you take 30%% less damage. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.bulwark.tradeoff: Without a shield in hand you take +10%% damage.
spec.extremeprogression.juggernaut.abili: For 8 seconds no knockback and 40%% less damage, but you cannot sprint. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.juggernaut.trade: −10%% movement speed with 3 or more pieces of iron or heavier.
spec.extremeprogression.resilience.style: Recovery instead of plate: shaking off effects and recovering fast.
spec.extremeprogression.resilience.abili: Removes every negative effect at once, plus 6 hearts of healing over 5 seconds. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.prospector.style: Finding ores and getting more from them.
spec.extremeprogression.prospector.abili: For 10 seconds ores within 12 blocks glow through the walls. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.prospector.trade: −10%% breaking speed on plain stone and deepslate.
spec.extremeprogression.excavator.abilit: For 8 seconds your shovel breaks 3×3 blocks at once. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.tunneler.ability: For 8 seconds you break 1×3 blocks (rank V: 3×3). Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.tunneler.tradeof: No chance of double drops, not even the trunk's, and ores give −25%% XP.
spec.extremeprogression.lumberjack.abili: The next tree you hit within 6 seconds falls at once, every log costing durability. Rank I: up to 16 logs, rank V: up to 64. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.lumberjack.trade: Wild plants give −50%% XP and no bonus yield.
spec.extremeprogression.gatherer.style: Gathering what grows in the wild.
spec.extremeprogression.gatherer.ability: For 10 seconds all wild plants give 3× yield. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.herbalist.abilit: For 30 seconds all food you eat gives double saturation, plus 5 seconds of Regeneration I. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.herbalist.tradeo: Cultivated food (bread, crops, meat from bred animals) fills 20%% less.
spec.extremeprogression.grower.ability.d: For 10 seconds crops give double yield and replant themselves. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.grower.tradeoff: Breeding gives −50%% XP and no bonuses.
spec.extremeprogression.herder.ability.d: For 10 seconds animals within 16 blocks follow you without food, and your next breeding gives twins. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.herder.tradeoff: Crops give no extra yield, not even the trunk's.
spec.extremeprogression.beastmaster.styl: Wolves, cats, horses, camels and the like.
spec.extremeprogression.beastmaster.abil: For 15 seconds your tamed wolves within 24 blocks get Strength and Resistance and attack your target. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.beastmaster.trad: You deal −10%% melee damage yourself while one of your tamed wolves is within 16 blocks.
spec.extremeprogression.angler.ability.d: For 20 seconds fish bite almost at once (−80%% wait). Cooldown 4 min.
Your next catch within 30 seconds is guaranteed treasure. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.hookmaster.style: The rod as a tool against mobs and players.
spec.extremeprogression.hookmaster.abili: The next mob you hook is yanked to you and stunned for 2 seconds. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.wanderer.ability: For 10 seconds +30%% speed and higher jumps. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.survivalist.abil: For 20 seconds no hunger, and 75%% less damage from fire, lava, freezing and drowning. Cooldown 5 min.
For 15 seconds no fall damage, and +50%% jump height. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.forgemaster.styl: More metal from the same ore.
spec.extremeprogression.forgemaster.abil: For 30 seconds furnaces you open smelt 4× faster. Cooldown 5 min.
Your next repair within 30 seconds restores the item fully, with a 25%% chance that it costs no XP levels. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.armorer.tradeoff: Smelting gives no bonus yield and −25%% XP.
spec.extremeprogression.tinkerer.ability: The next item you upgrade or repair gets a permanent +10%% maximum durability. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.alchemist.abilit: For 30 seconds brewing stands you open brew 10× faster. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.alchemist.tradeo: Enchanting gives −50%% XP and no bonuses.
spec.extremeprogression.enchanter.abilit: At your next enchantment within 30 seconds you see every enchantment of each offer, and you may reroll the offers once for free. Cooldown 5 min.
spec.extremeprogression.enchanter.tradeo: Brewing gives −50%% XP and no bonuses.
spec.extremeprogression.hexer.ability.de: The next splash potion you throw within 15 seconds leaves a cloud twice as large that lasts twice as long. Cooldown 4 min.
spec.extremeprogression.hexer.tradeoff: Potions you drink yourself last 25%% shorter.
